blurb:
Voted Key West’s Best Jet Ski Tour – With Over 15,000 5-Star Reviews & Over 20 Years Experience.

Get ready for the ultimate Key West adventure as you ride a jet ski around the entire island on a guided 28-mile tour. This top-rated experience includes everything, no hidden fees, no surprise charges. You’ll enjoy a free second rider & complimentary shuttle pickup. Our expert guides will lead the way, taking you to some of the most iconic and scenic locations in the area, including the Southernmost Point, a secluded local sandbar, and several picturesque spots inside the Florida Keys Marine Sanctuary. Along the way, you’ll have opportunities to stop, take in the views, and even switch drivers, making it a shared adventure you won’t forget.

Please remember to check in one hour before your scheduled departure and bring a valid photo I.D. Guests aged 16 and 17 may drive a jet ski with a parent or guardian riding as a passenger, while guests 18 and older are welcome to drive solo.
